description: This file defines the internal class NatsQueueAdapterReceiver, which implements the IQueueAdapterReceiver interface for handling NATS streaming messages within Orleans. It manages connection setup, message retrieval, acknowledgment, and shutdown procedures for a specific NATS stream partition.

classes.name: NatsQueueAdapterReceiver
classes.description: An internal sealed class implementing IQueueAdapterReceiver for managing NATS streaming message reception, acknowledgment, and lifecycle within Orleans.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a new NatsQueueAdapterReceiver with provided configuration.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the consumer connection for a specific partition with a timeout.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the receiver, awaiting any outstanding tasks.

methods.name: GetQueueMessagesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves messages from the NATS stream, deserializes them into batch containers, and returns the list.

methods.name: MessagesDeliveredAsync
methods.description: Acknowledges the delivery of messages back to NATS, if applicable.
